description: This file defines a configuration class for the Recraft v3 Text-to-Image model within the litellm project. It includes methods for parameter validation, mapping OpenAI-style parameters to Recraft-specific parameters, transforming API requests, and processing API responses. The class extends a base configuration class, and the file interacts with external modules such as httpx and various internal types for image objects and responses.
